successCriteria.description: Define the `LeaveBalance` interface in `src/modules/leave/leave-balance.model.ts` with all specified fields: id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, pendingDays, fiscalYear, status (BalanceStatus), createdAt, updatedAt

Define `ILeaveBalanceRepository` interface with methods: findById(id: string), findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string), findByEmployeeAndPolicy(employeeId: string, policyId: string, fiscalYear: number), create(data), update(id, data), upsert(data)

Implement `LeaveBalanceRepository` class extending `BaseRepository<LeaveBalance>` and implementing `ILeaveBalanceRepository`, with all six methods backed by parameterized SQL queries against the `leave_balance` table

Include Jest unit tests at `tests/unit/modules/leave/leave-balance.repository.test.ts` covering all repository methods (findById, findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeAndPolicy, create, update, upsert) with mock pg Pool
`BalanceStatus` is imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` (Phase 1 dependency) and `BaseRepository` from `src/shared/base-repository.ts` (Phase 2 dependency)

constraints: All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — the `LeaveBalanceRepository` extends `BaseRepository<LeaveBalance>` and uses its `query()` method for all SQL

Follow the established pattern from `LeavePolicyRepository` (Phase 3): interface + implementation class, constructor accepting optional `Pool` override, parameterized SQL with snake_case column mapping
No `any` types — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS constraint `no-any`)
`LeaveBalance` model must import `BalanceStatus` from `src/shared/types/index.ts` (Phase 1) and repository must import `BaseRepository` from `src/shared/base-repository.ts` (Phase 2)
outOfScope: Service-layer business logic (balance arithmetic, pending-days transitions, validation against policy) — deferred to Phase 6
Audit record creation — handled at the service layer per GP-002, not in the repository itself
Database migration for the `leave_balance` table — the table is assumed to exist per the architecture
RBAC enforcement — handled at the route/middleware layer per GP-005
The `ROLLED_OVER` BalanceStatus variant mentioned in ARCHITECTURE.md but absent from the Phase 1 enum — this is a pre-existing gap from Phase 1, not resolvable in this phase

options: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year) DO UPDATE SET all non-key fields
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_policy_id) DO UPDATE (ignoring fiscal_year in the conflict target)
Use a SELECT-then-INSERT-or-UPDATE pattern instead of ON CONFLICT
